title: 阿里千亿配售背后：AI投入与市场承压
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I mean, let's start with you on just really the size and scope of this, of course, cash call.
segments.zh: 我们先从规模说起，这次融资规模不小。

segments.en: Yeah, they're raising $10 billion, right? Which if you remember from the quarterly earnings, 10 billion was about what they spent on AI spending in one quarter alone.
segments.zh: 是的，他们筹集了100亿美元，记得上季度财报中，AI支出一个季度就花了这么多。

segments.en: And they're selling about 700 over million shares at a slight discount, 3.6% discount to the US ADR closing price.
segments.zh: 他们以较美国市场收盘价折价3.6%出售约7亿股。

segments.en: Now, mind you, we showed the charge earlier. The Friday closing price was already 8% lower.
segments.zh: 注意，周五收盘价已经下跌了8%。

segments.en: So a huge hit. Part of it could be the quarterly earnings, which saw a 75% decline on its profits.
segments.zh: 影响很大，部分原因是季度财报显示利润下降了75%。

segments.en: But this is the largest ever follow on share sale in Hong Kong.
segments.zh: 这是香港市场有史以来最大规模的后续发行。

segments.en: And the largest share sale since 2021, but seems like for now investors are not too impressed about the profitability of this company.
segments.zh: 也是2021年以来最大规模的权益资产发行，但市场参与者似乎对公司的盈利能力并不买账。

segments.en: As any, let me bring you in. The block trading dynamics here at work.
segments.zh: 接下来，我们看看大宗交易的动态。

segments.en: It's a very heavy block, right? The size on its own in isolation for the stock is a lot.
segments.zh: 这是一笔非常大的大宗交易，单看规模就很大。

segments.en: It's about 3.3 times ADV. So it'll take some time for people to get out of this if they are flippers.
segments.zh: 大约是日均成交量的3.3倍，所以如果短线交易者想退出，需要一些时间。

segments.en: So the structure of the book is going to be very important, right? Who did this deal go to?
segments.zh: 所以这笔交易的结构非常重要，对吧？这笔交易给了谁？

segments.en: Did it go to sticky kind of pension money, sovereign wealth money, or how did it go to hedge funds?
segments.zh: 是给了养老金、主权财富基金这类长期资金，还是对冲基金？

segments.en: That's the first dynamic. The second dynamic is we are in a very quiet period of volume here in Hong Kong, right?
segments.zh: 这是第一个动态。第二个动态是，香港市场目前处于成交清淡期。

segments.en: Volumes have been coming off a cliff into summer. And this is around one third of the entire market-stated volume, right?
segments.zh: 成交量在夏季大幅下滑。这笔交易约占整个市场成交量的三分之一。

segments.en: On Friday, we traded around 30 billion US overall. So this is going to continue to weigh on HSTEC in particular.
segments.zh: 周五整体成交约300亿美元。这将继续对恒生科技指数构成压力。
